title: Evolving Agents in the Dark: Retrospective Harness Optimization via Self-Preference
abstract: arXiv:2606.05922v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI agents rely on a harness of skills, tools, and workflows to solve complex problems. Continually improving this harness is essential for adapting to new tasks. However, existing optimization methods typically require ground-truth validation sets, yet such labeled data is difficult to acquire in practical deployment settings. To address this problem, we introduce Retrospective Harness Optimization (RHO), a self-supervised method that optimizes the agent harness using only past trajectories. Specifically, RHO selects a diverse coreset of challenging tasks from past trajectories and re-solves them in parallel. The agent analyzes these rollouts using self-validation and self-consistency, then generates candidate harness updates and selects the most effective one by its own pairwise self-preference. translated_title: 暗中进化的智能体：基于自我偏好的回顾式框架优化
translated_abstract: AI 智能体依赖由技能、工具和工作流组成的框架（harness）来解决复杂问题。持续改进这一框架对于适应新任务至关重要。然而，现有的优化方法通常需要真实标注的验证集，而在实际部署环境中，这类标注数据难以获取。为解决这一问题，我们提出了回顾式框架优化（Retrospective Harness Optimization, RHO），这是一种仅利用过去轨迹即可优化智能体框架的自监督方法。具体而言，RHO 从过去的轨迹中挑选出一组多样化且具有挑战性的任务核心集，并并行地重新求解这些任务。智能体通过自我验证和自一致性来分析这些执行轨迹，随后生成候选的框架更新，并通过自身的成对自我偏好选出最有效的更新。我们在三个不同的领域对 RHO 进行了评估，涵盖软件工程、技术工作和知识工作。值得注意的是，单次优化……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种自监督方法 RHO，仅利用智能体过去的行为轨迹，通过自我验证、自一致性和成对自我偏好来优化智能体框架，无需真实标注的验证集，并在软件工程、技术工作和知识工作三个领域验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: RHO is a self-supervised method that optimizes AI agent harnesses using only past trajectories—selecting challenging tasks, re-solving them, and choosing the best harness update via pairwise self-preference—eliminating the need for ground-truth validation sets.
